reviews.title: Its experience on iOS phones is very bad.
reviews.text: This app performs very poorly on iPhones; it's sluggish, has a complex interface, and lacks notification sounds. However, it runs perfectly on Android phones. We hope you can improve it to make it perfectly compatible with iOS.
